== Summary ==
Before/after crops for [[Luke's Hunting Rifle (PC Errata 2013 slip)]]. Compared with [[Luke's Hunting Rifle]]. Lower part of the printed card (the area the slip covers, scaled to the slip's width) and the slip as cut from the sheet at 300 dpi; nothing else is edited.
